description: This header file declares utility functions within the beerocks namespace for handling TLV (Type-Length-Value) messages related to Wi-Fi radio capabilities, channel reports, and scanning parameters. It defines a class tlvf_utils with static methods for constructing and managing these messages, primarily used for communication between agents and network management entities.

classes.name: tlvf_utils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to construct and manage TLV messages related to Wi-Fi radio capabilities and scanning.

methods.name: add_ap_radio_basic_capabilities
methods.description: Adds a TLV for AP radio basic capabilities to the provided CMDU message for a specific radio identified by ruid.

methods.name: create_operating_channel_report
methods.description: Creates a report of the operating channel for a radio, appended to the CMDU message.

methods.name: add_tlv_channel_scan_capabilities
methods.description: Fills the CMDU message with TLV data about the radio's channel scan capabilities, focusing on 20MHz channels.

methods.name: get_channel_scan_map
methods.description: Computes a map of channels available for scanning for a given radio. The map is keyed by OpClass and holds vectors of channels.
